question: A calibration system uses the relation $R(V)=\frac{100}{V}$ to calculate a quantity $R$ from an input value $V$, where $V>0$. During routine operation, $V$ is close to $10$, so the system replaces the nonlinear function with its linear approximation near $V=10$. For one observation, the recorded value is $V=9.9$. The technicians compare the approximated result with the exact value to measure the accuracy of the linear model.(a) Obtain the linear approximation of $R(V)$ near $V=10$.(b) Use the approximation and differentials to estimate $R(9.9)$.(c) Calculate the exact value and absolute error in the approximation.(d) Determine the percentage error and comment on the accuracy of the approximation.
explanation: (a)For`R(V)=\frac{100}{V}`the derivative is`R'(V)=-\frac{100}{V^2}`At $V=10$,`R(10)=10\quad\text{and}\quad R'(10)=-1`The linear approximation is`L(V)=R(10)+R'(10)(V-10)L(V)=10-(V-10)=20-V`(b)For $V=9.9$,`dV=9.9-10=-0.1`Using differentials,`dR=R'(10)dV=(-1)(-0.1)=0.1`Hence,`R(9.9)\approx R(10)+dR=10.1`This agrees with`L(9.9)=20-9.9=10.1`(c)The exact value is`R(9.9)=\frac{100}{9.9}=\frac{1000}{99}`The absolute error is`\left|\frac{1000}{99}-\frac{101}{10}\right|=\left|\frac{10000-9999}{990}\right|=\frac{1}{990}`Thus, the absolute error is approximately $0.00101$.(d)The percentage error is`\frac{\frac{1}{990}}{\frac{1000}{99}}\times100=0.01\%`Since the percentage error is only $0.01\%$, the linear approximation is highly accurate for $V=9.9$.

options.A:
(a) $L(V)=V$
(b) $R(9.9)\approx9.9$
(c) Exact value $\frac{1000}{99}$; absolute error $\frac{19}{990}$
(d) Percentage error about $0.19\%$
options.B:
(a) $L(V)=10+(V-10)=V$
(b) $R(9.9)\approx9.9$
(c) Exact value $\frac{1000}{99}$; absolute error about $0.201$
(d) Percentage error about $1.99\%$
options.C:
(a) $L(V)=20+V$
(b) $R(9.9)\approx29.9$
(c) Exact value $\frac{1000}{99}$; absolute error about $19.799$
(d) Percentage error about $196\%$
options.D:
(a) $L(V)=20-V$
(b) $R(9.9)\approx10.1$
(c) Exact value $\frac{1000}{99}$; absolute error $\frac{1}{990}\approx0.00101$
(d) Percentage error $0.01\%$, so the approximation is highly accurate
